subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram from among the given options that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Girls, Students, Professional performers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff4022520bbca3a4a6e33e941b8721a6c617bd4960e813db992a082b4e19fb9c.png]
solution:
A girl can be a student and a professional performer.

A student can be a girl and a professional performer.

A professional performer can be a girl as well as a student.

The correct Venn diagram representation is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/216cb6439d3e00bd0773b06706ee260e20d07de78406d2edf82002dc3b8422f1.png] 

Hence, **'option 1'** is the correct answer.
